tools.name: list_measures
tools.description: List the county measures in the Should I Live Here? atlas: key, label, unit, period, direction, and how many of the 3,107 counties have a value. Optional text filter.

tools.name: find_measure
tools.description: Map plain words (for example "internet", "cancer", "crime", "cost of living") to atlas measure keys. Words the atlas has no data for come back in not_available. Those words are counted (word, day and app name only, no personal data) so the owner can consider new data.

tools.name: get_county
tools.description: All atlas values for one county, by 5-digit FIPS or "Name, State" (state name or postal code). Missing values stay null with their status.

tools.name: compare_counties
tools.description: Compare 2 to 10 counties side by side on chosen measures.

tools.name: rank_counties
tools.description: Rank counties in the lower 48 states on weighted measures, with the same scoring as the site's My priorities. Rank 1 has the lowest concern score. Counties with missing data are left out, never scored as low. Optional limits and state filter. Read the cautions in every answer.

tools.name: request_measure
tools.description: Report a measure a user wanted that the atlas lacks, for example "schools". Only the measure name, the day and the app name are counted.
